about_the_game:
《Shape of Dreams: Prologue》 is a free prologue version of 《Shape of Dreams》, a game that combines MOBA-style combat with action roguelike elements.

The Rapids: A Realm Between Dreams and Reality

One day, the boundary between the dream world and reality collapsed, allowing passage to an intermediate realm called "The Rapids" through dimensional rifts. With rumors spreading that anything is possible if one reaches the end of the dream world, heroes step into this unknown realm, each with their own reasons.

Memory Editing

You can edit your memories to create your own unique character. Use memories from your past to defeat enemies in combat. Attach mysterious gems called Essences to your memories to grant special effects and create powerful synergies.

A ranged carry with absurdly powerful melee attacks? A self-destructing mage? Everything is possible!

Uncover the Secrets of The Rapids

The dream world is ever-changing. Dream dwellers, quests, various events, and hidden secrets await you in this procedurally generated world. The diverse secrets within this world will provide new experiences in every run. Unlock over 200 collectibles along the way. But be careful, the Hunters are always watching you.

Challenge Yourself Endlessly

With difficulty options and a permanent upgrade system, you can enjoy everything Shape of Dreams has to offer even if you're not particularly skilled at games. However, if you enjoy a challenge, ruthless trials await you, including Lucid Dreams that let you bend the rules of The Rapids and powerful hidden bosses. Overcome these trials and prove yourself!

Diverse Characters and Playstyles

Confident in your mechanical skills? Then we recommend Mist, a fast and agile melee character! How about Vesper, a tough and powerful tank? Or perhaps you'd like to carry your friends as a ranged damage dealer?

Shape of Dreams features characters of various roles including ranged carries, bruisers, tanks, mages, and more. Find the character that perfectly matches your playstyle.

Solo or With Friends

While Shape of Dreams offers a complete single-player experience, it also supports up to 4-player co-op multiplayer. Experience excellent cooperative gameplay through rich interaction systems including healing, buffs, and crowd control!
detailed_description:
Notice: Updates for the Prologue have been discontinued

🎉 With 500,000 Travelers journeying through The Rapids, our Prologue beta test has successfully concluded. We sincerely thank you for joining us on our journey to create an even better game!

Updates and support for the Prologue version have been discontinued.

However, all content that was added to the Prologue has been improved based on community feedback and updated in the Demo version. Since your saves will transfer over, you can continue your journey through The Rapids without losing any progress.

To celebrate the successful conclusion of the Prologue, we've updated the Demo with new items, a new Lucid Dream, and the Emote system, and we're also running a limited-time special Reverie event, so don't miss out!
